items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public exposure and medium for bounded changes adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and continue bounded read-only evidence work only; do not deploy, change permissions or configuration, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, add dependencies, or contact external parties.

Retain the existing security evidence matrix and private-launch gate only. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owners, severity, unknowns, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, TLS, dependencies, data exposure, monitoring, incident handling, and disclosure readiness. Missing evidence remains unknown rather than passed; no clean bill of health or certification is supported.

Ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, provenance, rights, platform-policy, and release boundaries, and adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not block ordinary growth for optional hardening alone.

For the gated product, keep public exposure blocked. Continue internal read-only evidence preparation only. Unresolved security gates include authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, monitoring, incident response, TLS posture, data exposure, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. No public exposure, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential change, dependency addition, or external outreach is authorized on this evidence.
